open_prs.title: Move the Sauganash stacks toward the ridge ends (T-2383)

The monolithic preflight timed out; neither result is relabelled PASS.
- Fresh published native Stage3 BOTH107/0 actually executed on saved00163 after magazine integration (390x780 and1280x800). This is Stage3, not all15runtime stages. Current PR-only changelog and ticket-ID questions passed against devff182 on a097; all old ROADMAP bytes remain a raw prefix and all old STATUS bytes remain verbatim.

**Draft / still unqualified:** actual current Hotel/body/source-credit BOTH review is pending the shared runtime workspace's release, and exact-head whole8shards+namedaggregate must pass. The review hold clears autonomously once the concrete requirements qualify; it is not an owner approval request.

Original T-2383 remains OPEN/PARTIAL after ordinary qualified dev merge. Shaft proportions/heads, compound roof and left-gable differences stay open; no camera/grade/date promotion, whole-image match or new photo ticket.

open_prs.title: Drivers wait for you and keep their pace
open_prs.body:
Selecting a named driver with Find now makes that same driver wait through lazy vehicle loading. Transport keeps its configured pace on slow frames, using the existing swept collision checks and a 0.25 m maximum advance per frame. Stop, Continue and inactive transitions reset without catch-up movement.

Validation:

- Local native coverage uses a reviewed source bridge: parts 1–3 passed on bf515d in 411.003/388.933/347.483 seconds; fresh part 4 passed on committed tree 8058a8 in 508.454 seconds. All original 600-second caps, 1,160 distinct steps and 402 self-tests are retained. The original part-4 T-2633 formatting-assertion failure is preserved. Only callback closing-brace whitespace and our new unit extractor changed; callback bytes/runtime tokens are equivalent, with fresh original Go to, transport-loop and driven-assembly units passing.
- The committed HEAD passes five QA checks, both whitespace checks and native publish/check, with the published build stamped b83f60edd8. Original test assertions remain intact.
- Fresh eight-part/core CI and moving/frame checks are pending. Root will dispatch the original complete published smokes as separate mobile/desktop jobs on this frozen feature HEAD: all 15 stages, unchanged 150-minute remote caps. The experimental low-FPS observer remains NOT READY and UNRUN.

Driver identity, route ownership, speed, gait bounds and assets are preserved. These are reconstructed actions and journeys; photographic/natural-stride acceptance remains outside this increment. Broad transport tickets remain claimed with pr:null; this partial increment does not settle them.
